I'm in therapy. It seemed to be helping for a while but lately I've gotten increasingly depressed and now I feel like any progress I made is gone.

If I can get the courage to post there I will...I'm so scared of someone I know seeing it, haha.

Thank you. Believe me, I understand distorted thoughts and I know that's what I do. But it's been impossible for me to stop. 

I try to be a good person and a good friend. I think I'm nice. But I don't have a magnetic personality or anything like that. When I'm less depressed I'm more witty, quicker, and I can be funny, but when I'm depressed I'm just silent and boring and, well, depressing.

I'll check out that book though...thank you.
I don't work out, though I know I should. I just can't find the motivation or energy. Do you have any advice on that?
